observations.body: Division, obedience, and a promised crushing. Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them. And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

payload.tension: The passage states division, obedience, and a promised crushing.
